My staff thoroughly enjoyed getting to sit down with 9th graders from Ontario High School today!

They discussed important issues like immigration, healthcare, and education. https://t.co/EXPuFK1W1G

The Affordable Insulin Now Act is the largest govt expansion of private insurance since Obamacare.

A better bill? I joined Rep. @cathymcmorris' Lower Cost, More Cures Act that increases transparency, allows HDHP's to waive deductibles for insulin, and caps it for seniors.

A momentous decision. Every human life is sacred. 

https://t.co/GxLm5q4FHZ

Great article on how drought can - and is - impacting all Americans (and the world). Those of us out West know just how dangerous severe drought is.
https://t.co/gMAuuhfc6r

It was great to see and speak to so many at the annual @amforest_org meeting this morning. As Chairman of the Water, Wildlife, and Fisheries Subcommittee, I will continue to advocate for policies that ensure improving the health of our forests and watersheds. https://t.co/jZiu6CtBUh

With recent fires in Oregon’s Second Congressional District, our forests can't be neglected due to failures of our forest management policies. 

That is why I support the Fix Our Forest Act as it will ensure the health of our forests, increase resilience to catastrophic wildfires and help protect our communities.

Recently, my office helped an Air Force retiree from Jacksonville get his Tricare coverage reinstated after he and his family were unexpectedly dropped.

If you need assistance with Veterans Affairs issues, passport services, or Social Security concerns, my office is here to help. Please don’t hesitate to reach out by visiting my website ⬇️

🔗 https://t.co/xjmOczQyI8

I am honored to have been appointed to the @HouseCommerce for the 119th Congress, chaired by @RepGuthrie. 

My subcommittees are: 
-Energy
-Health
-Commerce, Manufacturing and Trade

I look forward to serving on this important Committee.

Today, I spoke with Travis Joseph from the American Forest Resource Council (AFRC). I appreciated the discussion of the importance of the Conservation and Landscape Health Rule, O&C lands, and other priorities that are important to Oregon communities. 

Thank you for taking the time to meet with me in Washington!

Today, I sent a letter to @DHSgov Secretary Kristi Noem asking that her agency halt attempts by environmental groups to change how the National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP) is implemented in Oregon. 

These changes would undermine the program’s core purpose and impose unnecessary regulatory burdens on our communities. Oregon’s flood insurance should remain focused on protecting homeowners.

My staff is here to help! My office recently helped Mr. Steven’s in securing his Medicare payments after he could not access his Medicare due to the Change Health cyberattack. 

If you need assistance with a federal agency, call us at (541) 776-4646 or visit my website here ➡️ https://t.co/RKqyuz43fe

This morning, I joined KTVZ to discuss the serious challenges facing Oregon and our nation. In Congress, I will continue to push for fiscal responsibility, the preservation of essential programs such as Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid, and the protection of Oregon’s natural resources, especially as wildfires continue to threaten our forests.
https://t.co/H01r9kl4A7

As we work through this markup, my Democrat colleagues have engaged in speculation and out-right misrepresentation of the context and content of the bill. 

Let me be clear: Medicare and Medicaid are essential programs and they will be protected!

40% of my constituency depend on Medicaid. I know how essential and necessary Medicaid is. However, if we are to protect Medicaid so that it can continue to help people who are most vulnerable, we must prevent ineligible and illegal persons from wrongful participation.

Medicaid deserves protection, not exploitation.

Earlier this week, I sat down with Brinkley Hill at the KDRV studios to discuss the recent passage of the Reconciliation Bill, shared an update on Congressional priorities, the vital importance of Medicaid, and spoke about the future of forest management here in Oregon.

In case you missed it, you can watch the full interview here:

Today in the @HouseCommerce Health Subcommittee hearing, “Made in America: Strengthening Domestic Manufacturing and Our Health Care Supply Chain”, on which I serve, I raised concerns about our growing reliance on China for critical materials and the broader impact this has on our healthcare system. 

We must strike a balance between building a stronger domestic supply chain as it is essential to keeping healthcare safe and affordable for all Americans.

My office is here to help! Recently, we helped Andrew, an Air Force retiree, after he and his family were unexpectedly dropped from their Tricare coverage. My office successfully worked to have him and his family coverage reinstated with no lapse, making sure that they receive the care that they deserve! 

If you need assistance with a federal agency, call us at (541) 776-4646 or visit my website here ➡️ https://t.co/QEmHwnafGm

I issued a statement regarding recent comments made by Governor Tina Kotek about the impact of the One Big Beautiful Bill (OBBB) on SNAP and Medicaid. You can read my full statement below: https://t.co/oNPEDleeGd

Today, I had an excellent meeting with the doctors and staff at the Deschutes Rim Health Clinic in Maupin. Their work is essential to ensuring families across south Wasco County have access to quality health care. Thank you for your invaluable service to the community! https://t.co/c5qlil75CE

Great news for Union County! I was glad to support the Grande Ronde Hospital’s grant (see attached letter). Today, I am pleased to share that Grande Ronde Hospital has received the $2.2 million dollars from the EDA to renovate its Acute and Behavioral Health Care Workforce Development Center in La Grande, Oregon. This project will expand and modernize a medical office building. Once completed, it is expected to create 156 new jobs while also saving 121 existing jobs. 

Thank you to the EDA for their continued support of rural communities!

I sat down at the KDRV in Medford to discuss the recent passage of the Continuing Resolution, provided an update on Congressional priorities, the vital importance of Medicaid and shared insights from my recent Tele-Town Halls. https://t.co/xI7YibPp1p

Earlier today, I spoke with the Medford Chamber, joined by Commissioner Sparacino, about my work with the White House, the importance of Medicaid, key transportation and infrastructure projects in Southern Oregon, and the ongoing efforts in Congress to keep the government open and working for the American people.

Thank you to the leadership at Siskiyou Community Health for meeting with me today. It was great to discuss the recent passage of the Working Family Tax Cuts (OBBB), the importance of Medicaid, and the need to make healthcare accessible in rural communities. 

Also, it was great to learn more about your facilities and the work you all are doing to support the health of our community.

It was great to meet with the leadership of the Lake Health District in Lake County. We had the chance to discuss the Working Family Tax Cuts (OBBB), state-directed payments, and the importance of protecting healthcare for our rural communities. 

Thank you for your work to provide quality care for the people of Lake County!

Had a wonderful time visiting Rogue Community Health in Medford today! We discussed the passage of the Working Family Tax Cuts (OBBB), the importance of Medicaid, and improving access to healthcare across Southern Oregon’s communities. https://t.co/NcDO3Znc9u
